description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'TaxConfigurationController' that manages HTTP requests related to tax configuration settings in an e-commerce admin panel. It includes methods to display and save tax configuration, integrating with tax service and handling model attributes.

classes.name: TaxConfigurationController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling tax configuration management in admin interface.

methods.name: displayTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display current tax configuration; retrieves tax configuration for the store and prepares the model for the view.

methods.name: saveTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updated tax configuration; persists configuration and returns to the same view with a success message.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set the active menu items and current menu in the model for UI navigation.
